archive: Every comic, film, game, short and anime in the Blade Runner saga, told in story order across three eras. From the first Blade Runner to the city fifty years after K.
era1: The first Blade Runner, two war veterans in Tokyo and the traitor who left them for dead, Deckard's hunt, a rookie's case running alongside it, and Ash's first job. Seven stories, from the birth of the unit to the year of the film.
era2: The records burn and Tyrell falls. Ash fights a replicant who refuses to die, Elle hunts the men who hunted her, and Wallace rises to take Tyrell's place.
era3: A replicant Blade Runner finds bones under a dead tree, and the world that follows fifty years on.
people: The people who cross from one story to the next: Blade Runners, replicants and the men who make them, each with every appearance in story order.
lore: Ninety years on one line, the words the saga takes for granted, who is tied to whom, and where it all happens.
